metas.name: Sweetpea
metas.description: Season 2 · Sky Atlantic · Coming 26 Nov 2026 — Rhiannon Lewis doesn't make much of an impression - people walk past her in the street without a second glance. That is until she is pushed over the edge and loses control. Rhiannon's life transforms, but can she keep her killer secret?

metas.name: Toos: The Van der Valk Kidnapping
metas.description:
Netflix · Coming 26 Nov 2026 — Toos and her husband, Gerrit van der Valk, run the largest hotel empire in the Netherlands. But on November 26, 1982, disaster struck: Toos was kidnapped in what would become one of the most sensational cases in Dutch history.

While Gerrit and the children desperately searched, police officer Cor Mulder moved into Hotel Nuland to work undercover as "cousin Cor" to track down the kidnappers and keep the family afloat. The kidnapping gripped the entire country while Toos fought for her life in an undisclosed location. The media followed every detail, the government worried about the consequences of a possible ransom payment, and the perpetrators' demands became increasingly extreme. For…

metas.name: The Hunting Wives
metas.description: Season 2 · Netflix · Coming 26 Nov 2026 — Sophie trades New England for East Texas and falls into a wealthy socialite's magnetic orbit — where a clique of housewives hide deadly secrets.

metas.name: Ritus
metas.description: ARD · Coming 27 Nov 2026 — On the Night of the Moon’s Turning, the body of a teenage girl who has been missing for 18 years surfaces in a lake – intact, as if time had preserved her. The clues lead to an ancient ritual that has been carried out for millennia deep beneath the surface of a mountain. An eternal cycle that operates in secret - and exacts its price.

metas.name: Trinity
metas.description: Netflix · Coming 1 Dec 2026 — A heroic female naval officer becomes involved with the outwardly charismatic Secretary of Defense, only to discover that he may be at the heart of a dangerous conspiracy.

metas.name: Careless
metas.description: Channel 4 · Coming 1 Dec 2026 — Young Scottish backpacker Robbie lands a job in Sydney as a carer for music mogul Mike, who has multiple sclerosis. But does Robbie have sinister intentions?

metas.name: Bad Monkey
metas.description: Season 2 · Apple TV+ · Coming 2 Dec 2026 — A detective turned restaurant inspector in Southern Florida is pulled into a world of greed and corruption after a tourist finds a severed arm while fishing. And yes, there's a monkey.

metas.name: Pride and Prejudice
metas.description: Netflix · Coming 3 Dec 2026 — Elizabeth Bennet is an unmarried woman and the second of five daughters of Mr. and Mrs. Bennet from Hertfordshire, near London. The Bennet home can only be inherited by males in the family, so the pressure is on for the daughters to marry well or risk losing everything. While out in society, Elizabeth interacts with single men like Mr. Darcy, an outwardly curmudgeon who is misunderstood.

metas.name: Westend Girl
metas.description: Arte · Coming 3 Dec 2026 — The story of Ronja, a young woman about to begin her medical studies, is turned upside down when her parents are arrested and accused of running the largest cocaine network in the region.

metas.name: The Devil's Hour
metas.description: Season 3 · Prime Video · Coming 4 Dec 2026 — Lucy wakes every night at exactly 3:33am. Nothing in her life has made sense for a long time. But the answers are out there, somewhere, at the end of a trail of brutal murders.

metas.name: Alice
metas.description: HBO Max · Coming 4 Dec 2026 — From Paris's Belle Époque to New-York and early Hollywood, follow the remarkable journey of a visionary artist who defied conventions and expectations as a filmmaker, entrepreneur, wife, and mother. Her loves, her battles, and her relentless pursuit of recognition unfold against the birth of modern cinema.

metas.name: Strike
metas.description: Season 7 · BBC One · Coming 6 Dec 2026 — A war veteran turned private detective operates out of a tiny office in London’s Denmark Street. Although wounded both physically and psychologically, his unique insight and background as a military police investigator prove crucial in solving complex crimes that have baffled the police. Based on the bestselling novels written by J.K. Rowling under the pseudonym Robert Galbraith.

metas.name: Sunshine Girls
metas.description: Netflix · Coming 7 Dec 2026 — A sudden move from NYC to California lands go-getter Olivia at Valley High, where influencer Riley and horse-loving Taylor shake up her freshman year.

metas.name: Maxton Hall – The World Between Us
metas.description: Season 3 · Prime Video · Coming 9 Dec 2026 — When Ruby unwittingly witnesses an explosive secret at Maxton Hall private school, the arrogant millionaire heir James Beaufort has to deal with the quick-witted scholarship student for better or worse: He is determined to silence Ruby. Their passionate exchange of words unexpectedly ignites a spark...

trailerStreams.title: Maxton Hall – The World Between Us — trailer

metas.name: Who the Hell Is Hamish?
metas.description: Paramount+ · Coming 9 Dec 2026 — Inspired by an industrious fraudster, and the group of victims who eventually decided they had had enough of him, the charming and cultured Hamish sets his sights on Bec, a recently divorced single mother with three sons and access to a significant family trust. When Bec notices gaps in his story and some odd behaviour, what starts as private unease widens into something far larger: a pattern of deception spanning continents and suspected of leaving more than $70 million in its wake.

trailerStreams.title: Who the Hell Is Hamish? — trailer

metas.name: The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey
metas.description: Netflix · Coming 10 Dec 2026 — The series centers on one of the most infamous unsolved murder cases in American history, and the devastating personal and public reckoning that followed the death of JonBenet Ramsey on Christmas night in 1996.

metas.name: Unaccustomed Earth
metas.description: Netflix · Coming 17 Dec 2026 — When a health crisis forces a devoted mother and her family to return to the US, she confronts buried desires that upend her Indian American community.

metas.name: Frisco King
metas.description: Paramount+ · Coming 18 Dec 2026 — After declining an assignment to kill Dwight Manfredi on behalf of New York mobsters, hitman Russell Lee Washington Jr. sets out to start a new life – and enterprise – in Frisco, Texas.

metas.name: Harry Potter
metas.description: HBO Max · Coming 25 Dec 2026 — There is nothing special about Harry Potter - at least that's what his Aunt Petunia always says. On his 11th birthday, a letter of admittance to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry opens up a hidden world for Harry: one of fun, friendship and magic. But with this new adventure comes great risk as Harry is forced to face a dangerous enemy from his past.

metas.name: The Åre Murders
metas.description: Season 2 · Netflix · Coming 27 Dec 2026 — Two resourceful yet troubled detectives investigate a series of crimes in the snowy resort town of Åre.

metas.name: Mayfair Witches
metas.description: Season 3 · AMC · Coming 30 Dec 2026 — An intuitive young neurosurgeon discovers that she is the unlikely heir to a family of witches. As she grapples with her newfound powers, she must contend with a sinister presence that has haunted her family for generations.

metas.name: Black Snow
metas.description: Season 3 · Stan · Coming 31 Dec 2026 — Unsolved murders, missing people, cold cases. How do you cope with not knowing what happened? Detective James Cormack (Travis Fimmel) is focused on solving cold-case mysteries. At the same time, he’s haunted by his personal quest to find his younger brother, who vanished when they were children.

metas.name: The Day
metas.description: Paramount+ · Coming 31 Dec 2026 — Police stumble upon a bank robbery mid-heist, and the criminals barricade themselves inside. A hostage negotiator battles time and mounting pressure to save the hostages during a tense siege.

metas.name: The Twin
metas.description: Netflix · Coming 1 Jan 2027 — Suffocating in a loveless marriage to Adam, Nicola’s life takes a dramatic turn when Adam’s long-estranged identical twin brother Lee comes crashing back into her life, and their tangled romantic past threatens to destroy the present. A split-second decision and a terrible accident drives Nicola to protect her children, and over the course of one week, Lee and Nicola are forced together, struggling to maintain a web of secrets and lies. Though they can’t ignore their feelings for each other, they both know they’re living on borrowed time.

metas.name: The Wanted Man
metas.description: Apple TV+ · Coming 6 Jan 2027 — For 20 years, Felix Carmichael has been the untouchable leader of Britain's most feared criminal empire. But when a betrayal within his ranks leads to incarceration, Felix will risk everything to exact revenge and reclaim his throne.

metas.name: Baywatch
metas.description: FOX · Coming 6 Jan 2027 — Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Hobie Buchannon serves as a Baywatch Captain, leading new generation of lifeguards to the Southern California coast, where high-stakes rescues collide with attraction, friendship, family and responsibility. But Hobie's world is turned upside down when his daughter Charlie Vale shows up on his doorstep eager to carry on the Buchannon family legacy.

metas.name: The Rockford Files
metas.description: NBC · Coming 8 Jan 2027 — Newly paroled after doing time for a crime he didn’t commit, James Rockford returns to his life as a private investigator using his charm and wit to solve cases around Los Angeles. It doesn't take long for his quest for legitimacy to land him squarely in the crosshairs of both local police and organized crime.

metas.name: Bosch: Start of Watch
metas.description: MGM+ · Coming 10 Jan 2027 — Follow 26-year-old Harry Bosch during his earliest days as a rookie cop in 1991 Los Angeles, a city on the edge, teeming with racial tension, gang violence, and a fractured LAPD. Amid routine calls and growing unrest, Bosch finds himself drawn into a high-profile heist and a web of criminal corruption that will test his loyalty to the badge and shape his future as the detective who lives by the code, "Everybody counts or nobody counts."

metas.name: Criminal
metas.description: Prime Video · Coming 13 Jan 2027 — Follow the story of two friends, Leo Patterson and Ricky Lawless, one trying to fight his way out of the world of crime they were raised in, the other desperate to follow in the footsteps of his father, a legendary outlaw. And when Ricky's older brother Tracy returns home from the Army, their tragic family history comes home with him. Drawn into their orbit are Greta, a sharp-tongued car thief from Leo's past, and Mallory, Ricky's girlfriend, who fears what he'll do to get by. Gunfights, heists, and tragic romance are the order of the day, but will anyone make it out alive?

metas.name: The Spot
metas.description: Hulu · Coming 13 Jan 2027 — A successful surgeon and her school teacher husband suspect she might be responsible for a child's hit-and-run death. While looking into the matter, dark secrets are revealed that will test their relationship as they confront the possibility of hidden guilt and betrayal.

metas.name: 3 Body Problem
metas.description: Season 2 · Netflix · Coming 14 Jan 2027 — Across continents and decades, five brilliant friends make earth-shattering discoveries as the laws of science unravel and an existential threat emerges.

metas.name: Grown Ups
metas.description: Netflix · Coming 14 Jan 2027 — In Dublin, the Casey family's year of holidays and celebrations takes a dark turn when a concussion at a birthday party exposes secrets of infidelity, discontent, and financial troubles.

metas.name: Bloodaxe
metas.description: Prime Video · Coming 20 Jan 2027 — Follow Erik Bloodaxe, and his formidable wife, Gunnhild, Mother of Kings as they fight for the throne of Norway, the land is torn apart by fierce rivals, shifting loyalties, and bloody betrayals. With war looming and chaos consuming the kingdom, drawing in the ruthless Kings of other Scandinavian countries, and even a powerful English ruler, the stage is set for a thundering, cataclysmic, compelling and utterly magical new Viking Saga.

metas.name: Neuromancer
metas.description: Apple TV+ · Coming 21 Jan 2027 — A disgraced superhacker and a razorgirl assassin are recruited for a high-stakes heist targeting a powerful corporate dynasty with untold wealth...and secrets they'd kill to protect.

metas.name: The Palace of Secrets
metas.description: Netflix · Coming 22 Jan 2027 — Julia Ponce, daughter of a court painter, meets crown prince Gonzalo in a court filled with ambition, deceit, and revenge, navigating clandestine encounters and power struggles.

metas.name: She's Fine
metas.description: Apple TV+ · Coming 27 Jan 2027 — Fresh off a messy divorce, Heidi sets out to secure a lively second act for herself and her kids. But when she stumbles into coordinating her father's retirement community sex dates, Heidi is forced into an unlikely alliance with his girlfriend’s perpetually single son.

metas.name: Memory of a Killer
metas.description: Season 2 · FOX · Coming 2 Feb 2027 — Angelo Doyle lives two totally separate lives — fearsome NYC hitman and sleepy upstate Cooperstown photocopier salesman and father. Both of them are threatened when he is diagnosed with Alzheimer's, a disease he already lost his older brother to.

metas.name: Embassy
metas.description: MGM+ · Coming 7 Feb 2027 — When the Embassy in London is attacked, a U.S. diplomat faces an impossible choice: protect the Ambassador or follow orders to extract a high-value asset. As a deeper conspiracy unfolds, she must team up with her ex, a British SAS soldier.

metas.name: The Interrogator
metas.description: FOX · Coming 9 Feb 2027 — Follows former MI6 agent Conrad Henry and his elite team. When conventional methods fail, his quirky charm, intellect, and behavioral tactics lockpick the minds of dangerous criminals.

metas.name: Prodigies
metas.description: Apple TV+ · Coming 10 Feb 2027 — Didi and Ren are two ex-child prodigies who have been together since they were children. Now in their early 30s, they are starting to question whether their very ordinary existence is living up to the extraordinary promise of their childhood. Inevitably, they find themselves asking the same questions of their relationship. As individual hopes and needs feed into and conflict with their shared lives, the series challenges the fallacy at the heart of romantic storytelling — that the tale is over when the heroes get together. In life, surely, that is just the beginning?

metas.name: Einstein
metas.description: CBS · Coming 12 Feb 2027 — Brilliant but directionless, the great grandson of Albert Einstein spends his days as a comfortably tenured professor until his bad boy antics land him in trouble with the law and he is pressed into service helping a local police detective solve her most puzzling cases.

metas.name: The Age of Innocence
metas.description: Netflix · Coming 18 Feb 2027 — A fresh take on Edith Wharton's classic novel of forbidden love in 19th century New York, The Age Of Innocence is a will-they/won't-they love triangle exploring themes of freedom, duty, identity and love in all its forms.

metas.name: Presumed Innocent
metas.description: Season 2 · Apple TV+ · Coming 19 Feb 2027 — A horrific murder upends the Chicago Prosecuting Attorney's Office when one of its own is suspected of the crime—leaving the accused fighting to keep his family together.

metas.name: The Day of the Jackal
metas.description: Season 2 · Sky Atlantic · Coming 1 Mar 2027 — An unrivalled and highly elusive lone assassin, the Jackal, makes his living carrying out hits for the highest fee. But following his latest kill, he meets his match in a tenacious British intelligence officer who starts to track down the Jackal in a thrilling cat-and-mouse chase across Europe, leaving destruction in its wake.

trailerStreams.title: The Day of the Jackal — trailer

metas.name: Wild Things
metas.description: Apple TV+ · Coming 16 Apr 2027 — Magic. Money. Massive tigers. Siegfried & Roy are world-famous entertainers who push illusions to the extreme, as much in their private lives as their Las Vegas shows-until one fateful night unleashes a tragic mystery. Inspired by a true story.

metas.name: Off Campus
metas.description: Season 2 · Prime Video · Coming 28 Apr 2027 — Hannah Wells tutors hockey captain Garrett Graham to win over her crush. Their deal becomes real connection as they face their pasts. Friends Logan, Dean, Tucker, and Allie navigate college life and love.
